metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the cold candle, morning prayer, the quiet Mistress Ansell heard, and the sheet stopped after the dagger.

yesterday: The dagger is in. The sheet stops after it, before the two fathers.
One candle burned down. Mistress Ansell heard the quiet and said so.
Tuesday, after a quarter past ten, she has your back for Leadenhall.
The March page is still open, and so are the fourteen lines.
